observations: Two Sony PlayStation 4 consoles are stacked on a wooden surface.
The top console is an original 'Fat' model with a split glossy and matte top cover.
The bottom console is a PS4 Pro model, identifiable by its three-layer design.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top: one solid black and one translucent white.
The 'SONY' and 'PS4' logos are visible on the top console in photo 0.
A large watermark 'BUCHI_TECH' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' covers the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The term 'High version' is ambiguous; it could refer to firmware or hardware revision. The photo shows a glossy-lid model (CUH-10xx/11xx), which is an older revision than the 'all-matte' CUH-12xx.
Photo 0 shows two controllers, satisfying the claim of at least one.
No game discs are visible in the photo.

risks.proof: A photo of only the items included in the sale (one console, one pad, one disc).
risks.if_unproven: as the PS4 Fat model only, despite the Pro being pictured.

risks.proof: A photo of the model number sticker (e.g., CUH-1215) on the rear or bottom.
A video of the console booting to the home screen and launching a game.
A screenshot of the 'System Storage' settings menu.
A photo of the console with a handwritten note of the seller's name and today's date.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a TV showing the 'System Information' screen.
Clarification on why a PS4 Pro is pictured if only a 'ps4 fat' is for sale.
Photo of the disc mentioned in the description.
Photo of the console with a handwritten note of your name and today's date to verify ownership.
response.reason: The listing is contradictory; the text describes a single PS4 Fat and one controller, but the photo shows a stack of two different consoles (Fat and Pro) and two controllers. Additionally, the 'High version' claim is unverified and the presence of a third-party watermark suggests the photo may not belong to the seller.
